summary: A Deer Park, Texas officer was suspended for 10 days after an internal audit found he ran license plates 165 times for personal use. The department added new safeguards and a transparency portal.

title: Washington Post: departments missed misuse until an audit tool found it
summary: The Washington Post used Flock's Audit Assistance tool to identify officers who misused the camera network without their departments knowing. Savannah police said several of the identified employees had already been fired.

summary: A Chandler, Arizona officer resigned after admitting he used the Flock system to find a family member with health issues. Four metro Phoenix police agencies opened investigations into related misuse.

title: Polk County task force officer facing four charges

title: At least 20 Georgia officials arrested in Flock misuse wave
summary: A statewide wave in Georgia has led to at least 20 arrests of police and sheriffs officials for misusing Flock license plate reader access, one of the largest clusters of enforcement anywhere.

title: At least 50 officers nationwide accused of Flock misuse
summary: Media reviews counted at least 50 officers nationwide accused of misusing Flock Safety cameras, spanning stalking, personal lookups, and other unauthorized uses.

title: From crime tool to immigration surveillance: function creep
summary: Documentation of Flock camera networks expanding from local crime response into federal immigration enforcement, showing how a system built for one purpose drifts into others.

title: The early landmark: an officer's blackmail scheme using plate data
summary: One of the first documented abuses of automated license plate readers: an officer used plate data to find and blackmail drivers, a case the EFF cites in its surveillance self-defense guide.
